request.style: English, gospel, male solo with gospel choir, acoustic guitar, piano, drums, bass, cymbals, triumphant and urgent, 120 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Elisha called a young disciple
Tuck in your cloak and go to Ramoth-gilead
Find Jehu son of Nimshi
Pour oil on his head and declare his name

[Chorus]
Jehu is king over Israel
The LORD has spoken and the judgment comes
Strike down the house of Ahab
Avenge the prophets and the blood they shed

[Verse]
They spread their cloaks on the steps
Trumpets blew the message loud
Jehu rode his chariot fast
Toward the walls of Jezreel
Joram saw him and asked
Do you come in peace today
Jehu said what do you know of peace
As long as idolatry remains

[Chorus]
Jehu is king over Israel
The LORD has spoken and the judgment comes
Strike down the house of Ahab
Avenge the prophets and the blood they shed

[Verse]
Jehu drew his bow and shot
The arrow pierced the king's heart
He fell in his chariot
On Naboth's plot of ground
Ahaziah fled in fear
But arrows found him on the road
He died at Megiddo
His body taken to Jerusalem

[Chorus]
Jehu is king over Israel
The LORD has spoken and the judgment comes
Strike down the house of Ahab
Avenge the prophets and the blood they shed

[Bridge]
Jezebel painted her eyes
Looking out the window in pride
She asked is it peace, you Zimri
Who is on my side, who
Throw her down from the window
Horses trampled her to dust

[Outro]
Dogs devoured her flesh
As Elijah foretold in the text
No one buried her name
Judgment fulfilled in Jezreel
